html: † [עֲרִיסָה] n.f. meaning dub., usually coarse meal; 𝔊 AV RV dough, so Toy (with?) (NH עַרְסָן barley-meal; Syriac ܐܰܪܣܳܢܳܐ (in Lexx) hulled barley, or (cf. LagGGN 1889, 301 f.) wheat); > Sm Ez Co Ez kneading-trough (so NH עֲרִיסָה Jastr; appar. secondary, עֲרִיסָה also [bed], cradle, v. ערשׂ);—only רֵאשִׁית עֲרִיסֹתֵיכֶם Ez 44:30, ר׳ עֲרִיסֹתֵינוּ Ne 10:38; ר׳ עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם Nu 15:20, 21 (P).
